## Purpose

Explain the student, instructor, or maintainer problem.

## Changes

Summarize the affected files and any user-visible behavior change.

## Validation

Record install, lint, build, and relevant manual checks. State which checks were not run. Use fictional campaign data in examples and screenshots.

## Deployment and rollback

Identify any hosting, generated-output, storage, or dependency impact and the previous working commit. Await maintainer approval before merging or deploying.
